cmd: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run test:unit

testChange.reason: Round-3 fixes moved three seams the suite encoded: the post-repair proof is now presence-and-not-prunable rather than absence (B1), so the reattach fake models the record surviving; the probe carries the whole selection so the dialog callback is a selection snapshot (B4); and the classification travels on the draft, so the controller no longer rebuilds the repair from its own map (B3). An override or a branch now settles before Create opens (B6), so walks that only fired `input` gained a `change`.

cmd: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run test:unit

testChange.reason: Round-4 fixes moved two seams the suite encoded. A destination override is now a selection change like any other, so walks that typed one and clicked Create gained a settle and an answer; and a probe whose token owns no opening is refused rather than answered `fresh`, so the two cases written against that fail-open now assert silence — D3s fail-open is for an enumeration that FAILED, which still holds. `[5_3] never applies an answer an earlier probe produced` now drives its questions through the real dialog seam instead of injecting resolutions nobody asked for, because the gate is against the latest QUESTION.
